name: console.log()
description: Outputs a message to the web console.

name: console.error()
description: Outputs an error message to the web console.

name: console.warn()
description: Outputs a warning message to the web console.

name: console.table()
description: Displays tabular data as a table.

name: String.length
description: Returns the length of a string.

name: String.slice()
description: Extracts a part of a string and returns the extracted part in a new string.
code: let str = "Apple, Banana, Kiwi";\nlet part = str.slice(7, 13);\nconsole.log(part); // "Banana"

name: String.replace()
description: Replaces a specified value with another value in a string.
code: let text = "Please visit Microsoft!";\nlet newText = text.replace("Microsoft", "W3Schools");\nconsole.log(newText);

name: String.toUpperCase()
description: Converts a string to uppercase letters.

name: String.toLowerCase()
description: Converts a string to lowercase letters.

name: String.concat()
description: Joins two or more strings.

name: String.trim()
description: Removes whitespace from both sides of a string.

name: String.split()
description: Splits a string into an array of substrings.

name: String.indexOf()
description: Returns the index of the first occurrence of a specified text in a string.

name: String.includes()
description: Determines whether a string contains the characters of a specified string.
code: let text = "Hello world, welcome to the universe.";\nlet result = text.includes("world");\nconsole.log(result); // true

name: String.startsWith()
description: Checks if a string starts with a specified string.

name: String.endsWith()
description: Checks if a string ends with a specified string.

name: Array.length
description: Sets or returns the number of elements in an array.

name: Array.push()
description: Adds a new element to an array (at the end).

name: Array.pop()
description: Removes the last element from an array.

name: Array.shift()
description: Removes the first array element.

name: Array.unshift()
description: Adds a new element to an array (at the beginning).

name: Array.forEach()
description: Calls a function (a callback function) once for each array element.

name: Array.map()
description: Creates a new array by performing a function on each array element.

name: Array.filter()
description: Creates a new array with all elements that pass the test implemented by the provided function.

name: Array.reduce()
description: Runs a function on each array element to produce (reduce it to) a single value.
code: const numbers = [45, 4, 9, 16, 25];\nlet sum = numbers.reduce((total, value) => total + value, 0);\nconsole.log(sum);

name: Array.find()
description: Returns the value of the first element in an array that pass a test.

name: Array.findIndex()
description: Returns the index of the first element in an array that passes a test.

name: Array.sort()
description: Sorts the elements of an array.

name: Array.slice()
description: Slices out a piece of an array into a new array.

name: Array.splice()
description: Adds/Removes items to/from an array.

name: Array.join()
description: Joins all elements of an array into a string.

name: Array.isArray()
description: Checks whether an object is an array.

name: Array.from()
description: Creates an array from a string or other iterable.

name: Number.toFixed()
description: Returns a string, with the number written with a specified number of decimals.

name: parseInt()
description: Parses a string and returns a whole number.

name: parseFloat()
description: Parses a string and returns a floating-point number.

name: isNaN()
description: Determines whether a value is an illegal number (Not-a-Number).

name: Math.random()
description: Returns a random number between 0 (inclusive), and 1 (exclusive).

name: Math.floor()
description: Rounds a number DOWN to the nearest integer.

name: Math.ceil()
description: Rounds a number UP to the nearest integer.

name: Math.round()
description: Rounds a number to the nearest integer.

name: Math.max()
description: Returns the number with the highest value.

name: Math.min()
description: Returns the number with the lowest value.

name: getElementById()
description: Finds an element by element id.

name: querySelector()
description: Returns the first element that matches a specified CSS selector(s).

name: querySelectorAll()
description: Returns a static NodeList containing all elements that match a specified CSS selector.

name: createElement()
description: Creates an element node.

name: appendChild()
description: Appends a node as the last child of a node.

name: removeChild()
description: Removes a child node from the DOM.

name: .innerHTML
description: Sets or returns the HTML content of an element.

name: .textContent
description: Sets or returns the text content of a node and its descendants.

name: .setAttribute()
description: Sets the value of an attribute on the specified element.

name: .getAttribute()
description: Returns the value of a specified attribute on the element.

name: .style
description: An object that represents the inline style of an element.

name: classList.add()
description: Adds one or more class names to an element.

name: classList.remove()
description: Removes one or more class names from an element.

name: classList.toggle()
description: Toggles a class name for an element.

name: addEventListener()
description: Attaches an event handler to an element.

name: removeEventListener()
description: Removes an event handler that has been attached with addEventListener().

name: Event: click
description: Fires when the user clicks on an element.

name: Event: mouseover
description: Fires when the mouse pointer is moved onto an element.

name: Event: keydown
description: Fires when a key is pressed down.

name: Event: submit
description: Fires when a form is submitted.

name: Event: load
description: Fires when a resource and its dependent resources have finished loading.
code: window.addEventListener("load", event => console.log("Page is fully loaded."));

name: setTimeout()
description: Calls a function or evaluates an expression after a specified number of milliseconds.

name: setInterval()
description: Calls a function or evaluates an expression at specified intervals (in milliseconds).
code: setInterval(() => {\n  console.log("I am logging every 2 seconds");\n}, 2000);

name: clearTimeout()
description: Clears a timer set with setTimeout().

name: clearInterval()
description: Clears a timer set with setInterval().

name: Promise
description: An object representing the eventual completion or failure of an asynchronous operation.

name: async/await
description: A way to work with promises in a more comfortable, synchronous-looking way.

name: fetch()
description: A modern interface for fetching resources (e.g., across the network).

name: JSON.stringify()
description: Converts a JavaScript object or value to a JSON string.

name: JSON.parse()
description: Parses a JSON string, constructing the JavaScript value or object described by the string.

name: localStorage.setItem()
description: Stores data with no expiration date.

name: localStorage.getItem()
description: Retrieves stored data.

name: localStorage.removeItem()
description: Removes a stored item.

name: sessionStorage.setItem()
description: Stores data for one session.

name: Object.keys()
description: Returns an array of a given object's own enumerable property names.

name: Object.values()
description: Returns an array of a given object's own enumerable property values.

name: Object.entries()
description: Returns an array of a given object's own enumerable string-keyed property [key, value] pairs.

name: Object.assign()
description: Copies all enumerable own properties from one or more source objects to a target object.

name: Object.freeze()
description: Freezes an object. A frozen object can no longer be changed.

name: .hasOwnProperty()
description: Returns a boolean indicating whether the object has the specified property as its own property.
